description: Right-wall mask for the sinusoidal channel's near-wall zoom-in, stitched from first_half_1 (top) and second_half (bottom). Model: center + drift*row + amplitude*sin(2*pi*row/wavelength + phase) - a near-pure sinusoid plus a small linear drift term accounting for the camera not being perfectly vertical relative to the channel. Fit via curve_fit against trustworthy edge points: watershed-style dark-region fill on frame_a (real dark/bright contrast), bright-ridge tracing on frame_b past reliable_from_px into that frame (its own dark exterior is not separable from noise - checked directly), with robust outlier rejection before the fit.
